content:
maya: hey team — quick Q. i'm on day 2 and working through the onboarding checklist. where should i post: badge access issues, desk keyboard/peripherals, laptop provisioning, app access requests, and which bots should i subscribe to (deploys, oncall, calendar)?

devon: hi @maya! welcome :wave: Badge & physical access — file in #people-ops or DM @nate (people-ops triages faster). For laptops/peripherals open an IT ticket via https://redwood/internal-it or run `/it new` in #it-support. For app access, post in #access-requests with the app name + manager approval. Bots: subscribe to @deploy-bot in your eng channels, @oncall in eng-oncall if you're oncall, and @calendar-bot for team events. TL;DR: #people-ops, #it-support, #access-requests.

maya: ty! is there a simple template for access requests? don't want to miss details.

samir: you can paste this into #access-requests: 
```
App: Zendesk
Reason: Customer support testing
Manager: @devon
Env: staging (or prod if needed)
Duration: permanente/dev account only
```
that usually speeds things up. also always mention the environment (prod/stage) and whether you need admin vs read access.

it-bot: it-bot: Ticket created IT-4512 for laptop provisioning. ETA: 2 business days. Reply with `status` to update.

natalie-hr: if your badge is stuck, we can arrange a temporary lobby pass. DM me your building and what day/time you'll show up and i'll coordinate. welcome aboard! :tada:

nate: ping me for desk/peripheral pickup. FYI we keep spare usb-c dongles and mice in the gear closet. also if you want quiet hours, join #quiet-hours and set your DND in profile settings.

maya: awesome — subscribing to deploy and calendar bots now. quick followup: which channel should i use for commute reimbursements? bike parking + transit pass.

natalie-hr: commute reimbursements go through Concur — choose expense type 'Commute' and cc people-ops. You can ask clarifying Qs in #people-ops but don't post expense screenshots publicly.

devon: one more tip — if bot DMs/chan notifications get noisy, open the bot DM and type `help` or mute the bot in the channel via channel settings. if something looks wrong, tag @it-support and include the ticket ID. enjoy your first week! :sparkles:
